synopsis.synopsisDesc:
REAP Renewable Energy Systems and Energy Efficiency Improvement Program.

Refer to Application Package AND Application Instruction links to obtain all necessary forms for a complete application.

Contact State Energy Coordinators with questions: http://www.rd.usda.gov/files/RBS_StateEnergyCoordinators.pdf
synopsis.responseDateDesc:
REAP Applications are accepted year-round.

For applicants requesting grants of $20,000 or less, that wish to have their application compete for the "Grants of $20,000 or less set aside", complete applications must be received no later than 4:30pm local time on: November 2, 2015, or May 2, 2016.

For applicants requesting grant funds of over $20,000 or funding for a combination grant and guaranteed loan, complete applications must be recevied no later than 4:30pm local time on May 2, 2016.
